prose.subject: Invoice INV-80525 from Oakhurst Catering
prose.body:
Hello Greywater Robotics Team,

Please find attached our monthly invoice INV-80525 for catering services rendered during the current billing period. The total amount due is 3464.37 USDC.

Line Items:
1. Corporate Lunch Service: 12 days x 450.00 USDC = 5400.00 USDC
2. Special Dietary Accommodations: 2 packages x 150.00 USDC = 300.00 USDC
3. Service Fee: 5% of subtotal = 285.00 USDC
4. Volume Discount: -2220.63 USDC

Total: 3464.37 USDC

Please remit payment to our standard account:
0xfa8ddcdb5293d8badfe36835e0b8c5cee432eb1a

Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date. If you have any questions or require a revised statement, please reply to this email or contact our accounts department.

Thank you for your continued partnership.

Best regards,
Oakhurst Catering Billing Dept.
